description: Implement ensemble engine, calibration engine, confidence engine, and contextual adjustments (player impact, tactical matchup) per design.md sections 6-7
steps: Create c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\app\prediction\ensemble_engine.py with EnsembleEngine class per design.md section 6 - combines multiple ModelPredictions with configurable weighting strategies
Create c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\app\prediction\calibration_engine.py with CalibrationEngine class per design.md section 10 - isotonic regression calibration using historical predictions

Create c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\app\prediction\confidence_engine.py with ConfidenceEngine class per design.md section 11 - assesses confidence from data quality, model agreement, historical accuracy
Create c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\app\prediction\player_impact.py with PlayerImpactEngine per design.md section 12 - calculates lineup impact on predictions
Create c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\app\prediction\tactical_matchup.py with TacticalMatchupEngine per design.md section 13 - analyzes tactical advantages
Create c:\FootballIntelligence\backend\app\prediction\contextual_adjuster.py combining player impact + tactical adjustments into final prediction
Create comprehensive tests: test_ensemble_engine.py, test_calibration_engine.py, test_confidence_engine.py, test_player_impact.py, test_tactical_matchup.py
Run pytest tests/test_ensemble_engine.py tests/test_calibration_engine.py tests/test_confidence_engine.py tests/test_player_impact.py tests/test_tactical_matchup.py -v
acceptance_criteria: EnsembleEngine combines predictions with static, reliability-based, and performance-based weighting
EnsembleEngine calculates model agreement metrics correctly
CalibrationEngine fits isotonic regression on historical predictions and calibrates new predictions
ConfidenceEngine produces confidence scores [0-1] from multiple factors
PlayerImpactEngine adjusts xG based on confirmed lineup changes (never fabricates player data)
TacticalMatchupEngine identifies advantages from structured features (never invents tactical analysis)
All engines handle missing/insufficient data gracefully
Test coverage >85% for all 6 new engine modules
verification: cd c:\FootballIntelligence\backend && python -m pytest tests/ --tb=short (all tests pass)
